[[File:ChrysalideVeergundark-BoS.png|thumb|right|250px|A veergundark]]
'''Veergundarks''' were a type of [[chrysalide]], monsters created through the use of [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]]. Kept in subzero paddocks, they were regarded to be nature at its perfection by [[Sorzus Syn]]. These beasts were used centuries later by [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], who boasted that they could fend off any [[Droid/Legends|mechanized]] foe.
